kept.heading: BRANDS ARE HIRING FORMER JOURNALISTS FOR STORYTELLING. OR ARE THEY? (4 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: More brands are hiring former journalists as storytellers, often to produce the original-data stories and service pieces that AI search tends to cite. More than 2,800 journalists have moved into brand editorial roles over the past decade. However, many hiring managers still default to candidates with linear marketing careers, and former editors with brand experience tend to win out over reporters.

kept.heading: TECH OUTAGES ARE CAUSING PEOPLE TO PANIC-BUY (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Recent tech outages across Microsoft, US airlines, and JPMorgan are driving consumers to stock up on emergency supplies. Costco is benefiting, with US comparable sales rising an estimated 11% to 12% in the final week of October compared with its typical 6% to 7% growth. Momentum continued into November as 21 of 26 generators tracked on Costco's website sold out. Sam's Club and home improvement retailers are also seeing increased demand.

kept.heading: WHEN INFLUENCERS POST SPONSORED CONTENT, YOUR BRAND SHOULD... (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Your brand should actively support influencer content after it goes live rather than leaving all the engagement to creators. Have your social team comment on sponsored posts, reply to every comment, involve public-facing employees, share posts to Instagram Stories, and use reposts and tagged content to feature creator posts on your brand profile. For campaigns with multiple influencers, send creators links to each other's posts and encourage them to engage. Discuss these tactics with creators beforehand so everyone understands their role in promoting the partnership.

kept.heading: MAKE THEM TYPE THE PROMO CODE: WHY A LITTLE EFFORT BEATS AN AUTOMATIC DISCOUNT IN DIGITAL SHOPPING (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Requiring customers to enter a promo code can generate more sales than automatically applying the same discount. A study found that a 15% discount redeemed through a promo code converted at 1.45%, compared with 0.91% for an automatic discount. The small action makes customers feel like they earned the deal, increasing their sense of value and likelihood of redeeming it. The tactic works best for modest discounts of 10% to 15%, but the effort should remain minimal. Additional steps can create frustration and eliminate the benefit.

kept.heading: HOW BRANDS ARE GOING VIRAL WITH ADVENT CALENDARS (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Beauty and CPG brands are filling TikTok feeds with advent calendars before Black Friday, since one box can fuel weeks of unboxings and debates when each door gives people a reason to keep watching. Burger King releases only 110 calendars a day, so fans follow the drop before the doors even open. Red Bull added one pack-exclusive flavor that has fans debating whether to buy the whole box for it.

kept.heading: GOOGLE DEEP REVIEW (TOOL)
kept.blurb: Deep Review is an agentic AI system from Google Research that checks technical, scientific, and business documents for errors, inconsistencies, and weak claims. It supports PDFs and plain text. The tool provides two free document reviews per week.

kept.heading: AGENTIC-PMM CLAUDE SKILLS (WEBSITE)
kept.blurb: Join the waitlist to get access to a free library of Claude skills for product marketers. The skills cover product positioning, GTM readiness, competitor tracking, and more. The library will become available to waitlist members on December 14.

kept.heading: PAYPAL SAID HONEY FOLLOWED LAST-CLICK ATTRIBUTION, WHICH WAS THE WHOLE PROBLEM (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Last-click attribution can overstate the performance of advertising channels that capture sales rather than generate them. This is especially common in brand search, retargeting, coupon extensions, cart abandonment emails, and affiliate marketing. A 2015 eBay study found that turning off paid search ads had no significant impact on sales, even though attribution reports credited those ads with strong returns. Run incrementality tests to measure actual sales lift, exclude brand searches from automated campaigns, and revise affiliate terms to limit commissions for partners that only capture credit at checkout.

kept.heading: SAM ALTMAN WARNS AGAINST A FUTURE WHERE AI, NOT HUMANS, CALLS THE SHOTS (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Sam Altman and Greg Brockman oppose the idea of gradually handing control of society to AI as models become more powerful. Both believe humans must remain in charge but differ on how to prevent an accidental or intentional handover. Brockman stressed the growing need for better AI monitoring and security as models become harder to track through traditional chain-of-thought monitoring. Following a security breach, OpenAI redirected 25% of production engineers to security work.

kept.heading: AGENTIC SHOPPING - MAYBE NOBODY WANTS THIS (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Agentic shopping faces consumer trust barriers as shoppers remain hesitant to let AI agents spend their money. While AI is used to research and compare products, retailers want to retain control of the actual purchase and customer relationship. Catalyst Brands is investing in loyalty programs to strengthen direct customer relationships across brands like JC Penney and Brooks Brothers.

kept.heading: TIKTOK OUTPACES INSTAGRAM ON BRAND ENGAGEMENT DESPITE EQUAL REACH (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: TikTok turns the same reach into more engagement and faster follower growth, while Instagram Reels still lead every format on shares.

kept.heading: WHY GEN Z ISN'T FULLY LOCKED INTO THEIR JOB ‘SITUATIONSHIP' (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Gen Z is increasingly reluctant to commit to employers as layoffs and AI-driven job disruption weaken trust in job security. More than 30% of workers could see at least half their job tasks disrupted by generative AI. Meanwhile, 85% could see at least 10% of their tasks affected. This uncertainty makes exploring other opportunities more appealing. However, staying detached can limit career growth by weakening workplace relationships and access to promotions.

kept.heading: 40% OF ARCADE'S SIGNUPS COME FROM AI SEARCH. HERE'S THEIR PLAYBOOK (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Arcade is an AI video platform for marketers. It drives growth through 3 channels, with AI search generating 40% of signups. It hired a dedicated growth engineer to own AI visibility after an agency underperformed. Founder-led social contributes 20% through recorded interviews turned into a content calendar. Referrals drive another 15% through product features like invite flows and video watermarks. It also asks new users how they discovered the product and runs blind tests against competitors.

kept.heading: LINKEDIN'S CONNECTIONS EXPORT IS SHRINKING IN DECEMBER. HOW MUCH OF YOUR NETWORK GOES WITH YOU? (4 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Starting in December, LinkedIn will remove connections' email addresses and current companies and job titles from account downloads. Members will still be able to view this information on individual profiles. This makes it harder for companies to transfer a founder's network into sales and marketing databases or keep contact records updated outside LinkedIn.

kept.heading: I BUILT A COMPETITOR PRICE TRACKER FOR BLACK FRIDAY AND CYBER MONDAY (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: This piece provides a copy-and-paste AI prompt to build a competitor price tracker. Fill in 8 fields about the company and its competitors. AI monitors public pricing pages and records price changes and promotions. It creates a shared document with price comparisons and change history. A scheduled task keeps the tracker updated daily or weekly.

kept.heading: DELETING BLOG POSTS HURT AI VISIBILITY, BUT ORGANIC CLICKS TOLD A DIFFERENT STORY (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: AI visibility scores track how often a brand appears in AI answers, not whether those answers send anyone to the site. Blog posts tend to drive that exposure while service pages drive the clicks, so pruning the blog can sink AI reports as organic clicks hold or rise. Tracker data is also unstable, since answers change on nearly every run and the tested prompts aren't real searches. The solution is to compare Search Console's AI impressions with clicks to the same pages, and to add a “How did you hear about us?” field to inquiry forms.

kept.heading: THE LINK BUILDING INDUSTRIAL COMPLEX IS DYING (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Traditional link building is losing value as brands question buying backlinks based on domain rating rather than relevance and credibility. AI search requires more than backlinks or brand mentions, since being cited doesn't guarantee a product recommendation. B2B brands may get more value from visibility on review sites like G2 and Gartner than from paid guest posts. Podcasts, influential publications, and videos answering buyer questions are stronger ways to build credibility and earn relevant links.

kept.heading: GOOGLE ROLLS OUT NEW SEARCH HOMEPAGE WITH AI CHAT HISTORY AND NO SEARCH BUTTON (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Google made its AI-first desktop homepage official, swapping the Search button for AI tools and adding a sidebar of recent AI Mode chats for signed-in users.

kept.heading: HOW TO PROVE AN UNBELIEVABLE CLAIM (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Make bold claims more believable by providing specific examples that address buyer skepticism.
